purpose: fresh-seed re-validation of the corr40-split-v3-sinc high-band residual with a floor-corrected rule; registered before any tone of this seed is rendered
binary_check: v3 and v3-sinc output bit-identical to the 2026-10-29 validation build (8 renders)
inputs: 3 s harmonic tones to 8 kHz, f0 log-uniform 27.5-330 Hz, amplitude 1/h^tilt with tilt uniform 0.5-1.5, random phases; ideal reference = same harmonic set at f0*2^(shift/12)
metric: 1-8 kHz Welch (32768) energy farther than f0/4 from the harmonics; net residual = output inter-harmonic energy minus the ideal tone inter-harmonic energy, re output harmonic energy, in dB (floor -120 dB)
development_data: rules were set after seeing the 2026-10-28 study tones (27.5-55 Hz) and the 2026-10-29 seed 70711 tones; on both, v3-sinc net median is -67 to -82 dB, 98-100 % of cases <= -50 dB, improvement 17-21 dB at 44.1/48 kHz, worst +0.2 dB vs v3

pass_rule.R1: per rate: v3-sinc median net residual <= -60 dB
pass_rule.R2: per rate: at least 90 % of v3-sinc cases have net residual <= -50 dB
pass_rule.R3: 44.1 and 48 kHz: median (v3 net - v3-sinc net) >= 10 dB
pass_rule.R4: per rate: no case with v3-sinc net residual > v3 net residual + 1 dB

report_only: excess over the ideal tone (old metric)
cases where both engines leave a residual above -40 dB re harmonics (engine-level, not interpolation)
cases clamped at the -120 dB floor
rules: Commit/push this registration before rendering seed 86603
Single run; keep the result whatever it is; no change of seed, thresholds or metric after results
Synthetic tones only; no listening or real DI claim
Product Source/ and engine code unchanged
